facts.text: Full-time residential students must earn at least 35 Christian Formation Credits each semester through events like Chapel and ENGAGE Outreach, with at least 60 opportunities offered per term.

sources.title: Commuter Students - Dayton, TN - Bryan College
sources.quote: Full-time residential students are required to obtain at least 35 Christian Formation Credits per semester. Each semester, there will be a minimum of 60 available Christian Formation opportunities for students to receive credit.
